mintAuthority.summary: Arbitrum is PGOLD's only canonical native-issuance deployment. The proxy owner EOA 0x142a96da can call mint() directly, and the separate zero-delay ProxyAdmin 0x50ead2d2 is owned by EOA 0x7e5cc9bb and can replace mint logic. Ethereum, Pharos, and ApeChain token and pool controls are bridge representations assessed separately in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Pleasing issuer EOA — Arbitrum token owner (direct mint)
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472413865, owner() on proxy 0x3e76bb02286bfeaa89dd35f11253f2cbce634f91 returned 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4; eth_getCode returns 0x (EOA). The implementation at 0xd81ea1e2179c983a45aa95929f189c2bd59788d7 exposes a plain mint(address,uint256) gated only by Ownable, so the owner EOA can mint directly.

controls.label: Proxy-admin upgrade authority — Arbitrum
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472413865, EIP-1967 proxy-admin slot on 0x3e76bb returned 0x50ead2d211d84d111c692b86e02a489d3aa2e9ce (a ProxyAdmin contract, 3368 bytes). owner() on the ProxyAdmin returned 0x7e5cc9bb562eae2356fae7c59ea04c4677f73986; eth_getCode returns 0x (EOA). A different EOA from the token owner.

review.evidence: Canonical Arbitrum review at block 495272772 (2026-08-16): proxy 0x3e76bb02286bfeaa89dd35f11253f2cbce634f91 resolved to implementation 0xd81ea1e2179c983a45aa95929f189c2bd59788d7 with ProxyAdmin 0x50ead2d211d84d111c692b86e02a489d3aa2e9ce. The token owner 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4 is an EOA and its mint(address,uint256) simulation succeeded. The ProxyAdmin remains owned by EOA 0x7e5cc9bb562eae2356fae7c59ea04c4677f73986 with no execution delay, so it can replace mint logic. Ethereum, Pharos, and ApeChain token/pool mint paths are cross-chain representation machinery and are intentionally excluded from Mint Authority and retained in Bridge Risk. No named independent attestor, recurring cadence, or dated whole-supply reserve-to-liability report was located; the partial VISTO evidence covers only Arbitrum liabilities and partly observed bullion, so reconciliation remains unknown and supervision remains attestation-only.
